title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Free-Look Period Schedule
content:
Free-look periods of Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities, counted in calendar days from the contract delivery date.

| Tier | Free-look period | Free-look period when the contract replaced another annuity or life policy | Owner age on the issue date at or above which the senior period applies | Senior free-look period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | 10 days | 30 days | 60 | 30 days |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | 10 days | 30 days | 60 | 30 days |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | 10 days | 30 days | 60 | 30 days |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | 10 days | 30 days | 60 | 30 days |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 10 days | 30 days | 60 | 30 days |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | 10 days | 30 days | 60 | 30 days |

**Schedule notes.** The periods are the same on every tier. *Example (hypothetical):* an owner aged 60 on the issue date is at the senior age; an owner aged 59 is below it.
